newsitem.title: UK: P&O, Nedlloyd formalise container merger.
newsitem.headline: P&O, Nedlloyd formalise container merger.

text.p: British shipping giant Peninsular and Oriental Steam Navigation Co and Dutch Koninklijke Nedlloyd Groep NV said on Monday they had formalised their deal to merge their container businesses.
Under the deal, P&O and Nedlloyd will each take a 50 percent stake in the new company, which will be called P&0 Nedlloyd Container Line Ltd and begin operations no later than January 1.
The companies said in a statement that Nedlloyd's central works council had agreed to the merger, which remained subject to certain conditions.
In September, the companies said Nedlloyd would pay P&O $175 million to equalise shareholdings under the deal.
The merger would form a joint company with a turnover of nearly $4 billion and a net asset value of some $1.5 billion. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
